# AziHSM Sample - AES-GCM-ENCRYPT-DECRYPT

This sample demonstrates the AziHSM in the following scenario:

1. Generate an AES-GCM key within the AziHSM.
2. Use the AES-GCM key to encrypt data.
3. Use the AES-GCM key to decrypt data.

## How to run

> See top-level [README.md](../README.md) for prerequisites.

Run the executable like so:

```powershell
.\AES-GCM-ENCRYPT-DECRYPT.exe
```

You should see output similar to this:
